name: Doorcheck
tagline: Before you add someone else's bot template, Doorcheck reads its recipe (instructions, skills, routines, plugins it asks for) and returns reject, allow-with-constraints, or allow, plus a constraint card of what to keep off.
description: Before you add someone else's bot template, Doorcheck reads its recipe (instructions, skills, routines, plugins it asks for) and returns reject, allow-with-constraints, or allow, plus a constraint card of what to keep off. It never installs, runs, or connects anything; green is not "safe".
